headline: Fishermen's Row Changes Hands as Deadlands Fighting Renews
war_summary: The chief change since our last edition comes at Fishermen's Row, where the day's tally of base events has climbed from twenty-one to twenty-eight, seven falling within the past two hours and the latest logged at this edition's filing; its nine works now stand seven Warden to two Colonial, reversed from five Colonial to four Warden, with Dankana Post the busiest ground. The Deadlands, silent at our prior report, record two fresh base events, the latest near two hours old, their eleven works standing seven Colonial to four Warden. The Weathered Expanse now bears the war's heaviest day's exchange, some thirty-five thousand casualties in twenty-four hours, the latest hour cooling even as the two-hour rate climbs anew. Kings Cage has seen no base events since yesterday evening, yet its day's losses pass eleven thousand. Linn Mercy's fifteen base events all fall outside the past six hours, though its casualty rates remain heavy. Farranac Coast shows fresh acceleration without a change of flags. Sixty-five days in, no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
